texts.zh:
放逐我们的懦夫终于要行动了。

[marauder_heir.GetName]聚集在一起，要拥立我们的敌人为新的大可汗。

如果我们想要结束流放状态，那就要抓紧时机，在这个[Species.GetSpeciesNameInsult]巩固其权力并永远玷污我们的遗产之前，我们有十年时间对其发动挑战。

设定航线前往[marauder_rally_point.GetName]。
texts.en:
The coward who banished us is moving at last.

The [marauder_heir.GetName] gather to appoint our foe as the new Great Khan.

If our exile is to end, it must end now. We have ten years to challenge them before this [Species.GetSpeciesNameInsult] consolidates their power and forever stains our legacy.

Set course for [marauder_rally_point.GetName]!

texts.zh: 时刻已到。新的可汗即将选出。为了结束流亡，我们必须证明自己。
texts.en: It is time. A new Khan will be declared. To end our exile we must prove ourselves.
